final: WITH j AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, sc.scancount AS cnt, sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0) AS r FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), g AS (SELECT st, SUM(cnt) AS total_scans, AVG(r) AS avg_ratio FROM j GROUP BY st), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM g) SELECT g.st AS healtheval, g.total_scans, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_ratio AS diff_from_mean FROM g, m WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
